name: hermes-prime-mcp

tools.name: get_conventions
tools.description: Return the hermes-prime CLAUDE-fragment as raw markdown — the session-priming conventions (grounding triggers, tool map, rules-most-often-forgotten). Optional scope_class returns a scoped fragment from fragments/<scope_class>.md when present; otherwise falls back to the default fragment. Call once at session start to load conventions without polluting CLAUDE.md.

scope_class.description: Optional scope class (e.g. 'session-init'). Falls back to the default fragment if unknown.

tools.name: list_scopes
tools.description: List available scoped fragments (one per line). Always includes 'default'.

instructions: hermes-prime serves a versioned convention card for recursive or emergent work. Call get_conventions once at the start of such a session and read the returned markdown before planning; skip it for short single-task fixes. The card is advisory text: it does not enforce anything or call other tools.
